name: Prototype Builder
tagline: From request to something clickable: it builds, then returns screenshot and URL
description: Shortens the road from a request to something clickable: it builds the prototype on its own machine and sends back a screenshot next to a live URL. Feedback happens on a working artifact rather than a description, which is usually where the real requirements surface.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
